entities.name: Chandigarh Group of Colleges, Landran
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Chandigarh Group of Colleges are the educational institutions located in the Mohali district of Punjab, near Chandigarh and Mohali. The CGC was established in 2001 at Landran and in 2012 at Jhanjeri.
